description: This file provides IP address parsing and manipulation functions, including support for IPv4 and IPv6, with backward compatibility considerations for Kubernetes and go-1.17 changes.

methods.name: parseIPv4
methods.description: Parses a string as an IPv4 address.

methods.name: parseIPv6
methods.description: Parses a string as an IPv6 address.

methods.name: ParseIP
methods.description: Parses a string as an IP address, supporting IPv4, IPv6, and IPv4-mapped IPv6.

methods.name: ParseCIDR
methods.description: Parses a string as a CIDR notation IP address and prefix length.
